name: FTSH-107-01-L-DV-K 1.27mm 2x7 SMD header (Samtec)
description: Samtec FTSH series 1.27mm dual-row SMD header, 2x7 (14 pins). FTSH-107 is the STDC14 debug connector (ST UM2448).
dimensions_source: Pitch 1.27 dual-row per Samtec FTSH series (MPN named in ST UM2448 Rev 9 sec 8.1.2). Body L=(pos+1)*1.27, W=4.78 from FTSH-105 = 6.35x4.78mm (Arm ULINKplus UG 101636). Land 0.76x2.4 rows +-1.95 from antmicro/hardware-components samtec-ftsh-105 production reference. Samtec official print PDF blocked (HTTP 403) - to be cross-checked when obtainable.
